column4: account toor has UID 0 but is not root: it is a second superuser
account legacy has an empty password field: it can log in without a password
account alice uses an MD5 crypt hash ($1$): crack it with commodity hardware
account legacy has an empty password hash: it can log in without a password
account oldguy uses a traditional DES hash: only 8 characters count
system account www-data (UID 33) has an interactive shell: /bin/bash
UID 0 is shared by root and toor: they are the same identity to the kernel
UID 1001 is shared by bob and helpdesk: they are the same identity to the kernel
account ops keeps a password hash in passwd, which every user can read
user name alice appears more than once
account root has a password that never expires
account bob has a password that never expires
not a passwd or shadow entry (expected 7 or 9 colon separated fields), ignored
